Puzzle 963. Minimal quantity of Prime Arithmetic Progressions to...

Problems & Puzzles: Puzzles

Puzzle 963. Minimal quantity of Prime Arithmetic Progressions to...

Dmitry Kamenetsky poses the following nice puzzle:

Observe that the first 10 odd primes can be covered with a minimal of three arithmetic progressions of primes:

For X=10, K=3: {(3,17,31); (5,11,17,23,29); (7,13,19)}

What is the smallest number of arithmetic progressions of primes, K, needed to cover the first X odd primes? Do this for:

Q1. X=100

Q2. X=1000.

Contributions came from Dmitry Kamenetsky, Emmanuel Vantieghem

***
